_comment: The CLOSED ALPHABET every string value in a committed replay fixture must belong to (restructure spec §5.6 rule 2). Match literals exactly or patterns with fullmatch. Synthetic construction against tests/mock_jf.py remains required: membership is a vocabulary check, not proof of data provenance, and cannot distinguish private values coincidentally equal to allowed words/numbers. CLI, outbound guard and host tests share this policy. Add new protocol constants by source-backed name, never by harvesting an unchecked recording.

_sources.jellyfin_shapes: tests/mock_jf.py: sid() names every id as md5-derived 32-hex lowercase (items, people, views, tags), media sources live at /media/<id>.mkv, chapters are Chapter <n>, genres are g%04x, audio DisplayTitle is Eng - <codec> - Stereo with the eac3 codec beside the Plex-era aac/hevc/ac3, and OFFICIAL_RATINGS add G/PG/R/TV-MA/PG-13; jellyfin/browse.rs names the hub ids jf.nextup and jf.latest.<viewId>, pms.rs titles the per-view shelf with i18n browse_library_hub_recently_added plus the view's own name (Recently Added - s[0-9a-f]{8}) and browse_jellyfin_next_up (Next Up), and rows label episodes S<season> • E<episode>; the app's own formats add the duration (<n> hr [<n> [min]]), the locale short date, metadata.rs track labels eng (<CODEC>) and Direct Stream, the detail Favorite verb, and person.rs seed role labels Character <n>; app/recorder.rs features() carries the flavor name jellyfin; item image paths are /Items/<id>/Images/<kind>[/<index>] with the optional ?tag=<32-hex> etag.
_sources.localization: locales/en/settings.json names the Language destination (Language, its detail line and System default); locales/en/browse.json browse.person.credits pluralises the Filmography count, measured word by word as it wraps; i18n/mod.rs LocaleContext formats dates as ICU YMD short with a full year, and controlled System resolves to en-US, so the synthetic mock's 2011-03-14 reads 3/14/2011.
_sources.playback_settings: plex/session.rs DirectPlayMode serializes auto/forced/disabled and PlaybackQuality its persisted tags. screens/preferences.rs supplies the added Playback destinations, detail lines and root copy, and locales/en/settings.json carries the Width-measured quality labels (settings.playback.quality, settings.audio.original, settings.playback.auto). The lip-sync field title Audio sync is locales/en/settings.json settings.playback.lip_sync, and its default value label 0 ms is screens/preferences.rs::lip_sync_label. The end-of-episode field is locales/en/settings.json settings.playback.up_next (Next episode), settings.playback.up_next_auto (Play automatically) and settings.playback.up_next_window (Up Next card timing), whose step label 30 s is screens/preferences.rs formatting the seconds count with the suffix s over plex::session::UP_NEXT_WINDOW_STEP_S; settings.title is the root header word Settings.
_sources.controlled_content: app/bootstrap/effects.rs and bootstrap/stores.rs name content/metadata; metadata.rs MarkerKind/RatingArt; person.rs seed_dev_credits and filmography name the finite departments. The retired Plex mock built people thumb paths, plex GUIDs from sname, two-sname mkv filenames, a four-sname tagline and en/eng/srt/mkv media values. ContentReq::PreviewStop and ContentPanel::{About,Bio} serialize preview_stop/about/bio; the other preview/panel discriminators are object keys.
_sources.effect_and_machine_names: rust-modules/src/app/recorder.rs: Recplay::effect Fx match and machine_name exhaustive MachineId match
_sources.provenance: rust-modules/src/ui/present.rs: Provenance/ResourceKind; ui/machine.rs: MachineId and derived Debug InstanceId/StoreOrd/TimerId; ui/fixture.rs: Recorder::present formats Debug. Landing(Instance(4)) is NOT that format.
_sources.routes: rust-modules/src/app/words.rs: route_word, overlay_suffix and NO_OVERLAY; app/recorder.rs: AppInit::probe; screens/registry.rs word constants; screens/player/overlay.rs: OverlayKind names menu/info/chapters/more
_sources.trigger_subset: rust-modules/src/dev.rs: DIAG rec/focus/noidle, read(nowan); dev/scenarios.rs: token/settings/detail/detailsec/detailok/filmography; person.rs: personcredits. armed_triggers records filenames, never arbitrary =contents. This is a reviewed subset, not all possible runtime filenames.
_sources.commands: rust-modules/src/app/events.rs: ck/pat/txt dispatch; ui/testpat.rs: set finite pattern names and numeric argument structure; txt replaces plus with spaces, so only synthetic words are allowed (not hexadecimal credentials). Numeric patterns intentionally accept a subset of float syntax.
_sources.mock_shapes: The retired Plex mock: sname/swords, metadata thumb/art, part file paths, dates, summary length, media codecs/content ratings (the audio-enhancement items add aac and hevc) and hub identifiers; plex/hub_title.rs localized_hub_title replaces home.movies.recent/home.television.recent titles with locales/en/browse.json Recently Added Movies/Recently Added TV
_sources.record_vocabulary: rust-modules/src/ui/rec.rs: Writer record tags; ui/fixture.rs and ui/screen.rs: input/lifecycle names; app/recorder.rs: feature names and probes
_sources.focus_resolution_metrics: rust-modules/src/ui/rec.rs: Writer::focus and Writer::resolution emit fo/rs; MetricKey's serde tag names the Width/Cap/Line variants. app/recorder.rs emits the closed product-resolution payload kinds Focus/Hit. Width query literals come from the fixed UI copy in screens/settings.rs, screens/legal.rs, screens/home, screens/detail and screens/person; the bounded synthetic-name, role/count, character and resume-label patterns come from the retired Plex mock plus those screens' format strings. TextView's finite ellipsis outputs for the fixed crash-ID sentence are listed literally, not admitted by a general prose pattern.
_sources.controlled_home: app/bootstrap.rs: Initial::synthetic_home fixes loopback, emits the complete Seeded contract and a fixed probe; app/bootstrap/effects.rs explicitly encodes input Source/Key/Edge, lifecycle By, Home commands and store request names. auth/owner.rs declares ActivateDevBootstrap and ReadyInstall::AlreadyInstalled; auth.rs Phase::Idle and Picker::Boot, plex/probe.rs Location's lowercase local wire. No general UUID, hostname, token or capitalized-word pattern is permitted.
_sources.subtitle_preferences: rust-modules/src/plex/session.rs: SubtitleTone::White serializes as white and is the captured default in every synthetic session.
_sources.session_persistence: rust-modules/src/plex/session.rs: SaveAuthority::Routine (also PublicOnly, FreshReauthentication — already covered/unused in controlled recordings); rust-modules/src/plex/session/async_persistence.rs: PersistencePurpose::Background; rust-modules/src/auth/owner.rs: CommitAdmission::RegistryOnly. These serialize into every controlled session commit/plan once a store owns its own persistence (cleanup/ownership), so a synthetic recording now always carries them.
_sources.shape_history: tests/replay_fixtures.py --rebase-shape writes state_fp as the 16-lowercase-hex spelling rust-modules/src/ui/rec.rs prints in its refusal, plus a reason token naming what moved: screens/preplay_panel.rs PrePlaybackScreen::name() supplies preplay, which is also the overlay word that screen prints.
_sources.owner_language_discs: tests/mock_jf.py `_media_source`: every second item carries a Spanish AAC track (Spa - AAC - Stereo; codec aac, Language spa, ChannelLayout stereo) and subrip subtitles (Eng - SUBRIP, Spa - SUBRIP) beside the Eng audio, so the detail hero's language discs and the picker have something to choose between. metadata.rs RatingArt::Community serializes as Community and is the audience-score entry of every rated item; screens::registry PersonCmd carries the close word the filmography route echoes.
_sources.resume_labels: ui/widgets.rs and the resume rows that use it: the remaining-time label a card states while an item is in progress, 'N hr M min left' / 'N min left'. These three are the values the demo catalog's in-progress items produce now that every card in a row carries its caption, so the closed alphabet has to know them by name.
_sources.settings_one_page: locales/en/settings.json names the one Settings page of the owner's redesign mockup: its four group headers, the server row's value when nothing is signed in (settings.audio.not_set), the add-another-server row and its detail, and one short detail line per playback knob, plus the two playback values the old root never drew (skip intro and credits, Ask me). Each is the label or the detail line the table MEASURES through the Width metric records, so they join the alphabet by source-backed name rather than by harvesting the recording.
